name: Caspar Datsui Janken Game
original_name: カスパル脱衣ジャンケンゲーム
source:
Fire Emblem Three Houses fangame.

Play Rock-Paper-Scissors with Caspar von Bergliez and try to get him to strip. (Note: There is no nudity)

Includes auto-win and reset options.
translation:
火焰纹章三宫同人游戏。

与卡斯帕·冯·伯格利兹玩剪刀石头布，并试图让他脱光衣服。（注：没有裸露）包括自动获胜和重置选项。
